semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company provides equipment leasing and financial services for pre-owned electronics equipment, which can include semiconductor manufacturing tools.
summary: SMFL MIRAI Partners Co., Ltd. specializes in the leasing and financial services of pre-owned electronics equipment, catering to the semiconductor industry. They offer a range of services including brokerage, marketing, refurbishment, and technical support for used equipment.

regional_presence.Japan: As the largest equipment leasing company in Japan, SMFL MIRAI Partners has a strong presence in the local semiconductor market.
